zh-CN.title: 即时提醒支持更多接收方式
items: 即时提醒现可同时连接 Bark、ntfy 和 Gotify
系统会按手机平台展示合适的接收端，并统一管理提醒偏好

en.title: More receivers for instant alerts
items: Instant alerts can now connect to Bark, ntfy, and Gotify at the same time
Compatible receivers are shown for each mobile platform and share one alert preference
